blocks.content:
OCI is not full citizenship.
OCI card holders:
• Do not have voting rights
• Cannot hold constitutional posts
• Cannot purchase agricultural land
This is a very common trap question in exams.

items: Exams frequently set trap questions around OCI being mistaken for full citizenship.
Remember the three key restrictions for OCI card holders: no voting rights, no constitutional posts, and no agricultural land purchases.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: OCI does not confer full citizenship status.
OCI card holders do not possess voting rights.
OCI card holders are barred from holding constitutional posts.
OCI card holders cannot purchase agricultural land.
